about: Structure of one artwork record in data/artworks/<series>/<slug>.json. Blocks are owned by different processes: catalog by scripts/build_catalog.py, measured by scripts/measure_images.py, described and relations by a describing pass (Claude or Matt) and the local edit tool, author by Matt only.

blocks.id: Stable identifier, <series-slug>/<title-slug>. Never changes once created.

fields.title: Display title, from the Quarto page.
fields.series: Folder name under images/, as on the site.
fields.medium: Normalised medium: digital, oil, airbrush, marker, acrylic, gouache, ink, screen print, spray paint, vinyl, pen, ink and airbrush.
fields.surface: paper, canvas, wood panel, or null for digital.
fields.medium_source: Where the medium came from: description, title, or series.
fields.description_raw: The original EXIF description string, untouched.
fields.caption: Location or scene text that was stored in the description field.
fields.camera: Camera named in the description, if any.
fields.date: Creation date and time from the page front matter.
fields.availability: sold, not for sale, or null (unknown).
fields.physical_size_in: Physical size in inches from IPTC keywords, e.g. 12 x 12.
fields.process_notes: Hand written process notes from the page body.
fields.print_url: Shop link for a print, if the page has one.
fields.print_note: Any other text in the print section.
fields.image: path, width, height, aspect, orientation (square, landscape, portrait), bytes, format.
fields.page: qmd source, html output path, public url.
fields.source_metadata: Raw EXIF and IPTC values kept for reference.
fields.catalog_built: Date this block was last refreshed.

fields.palette: Up to 6 colours as hex with the fraction of pixels nearest each, largest first.
fields.hue_histogram: 12 bins over the hue wheel starting at red, saturated pixels only, sums to 1.
fields.dominant_hues: Up to 3 hue family names with more than 8 percent of saturated pixels.
fields.warm_fraction: Share of saturated pixels in red through yellow or magenta through pink.
fields.colorfulness: Hasler and Suesstrunk colourfulness, roughly 0 to 100.
fields.is_monochrome: True when the piece is effectively grayscale.
fields.dark_fraction: Share of pixels darker than 0.2 lightness, a proxy for heavy black line work.
fields.light_fraction: Share of pixels lighter than 0.9 lightness, a proxy for white paper or borders.
fields.edge_density: Share of pixels on strong edges, a proxy for amount of line.
fields.busyness: Mean local standard deviation in 16 px blocks, a proxy for all over detail.
fields.has_white_border: True when the outer 2 percent of the image is near white.
fields.phash: 64 bit perceptual hash as hex, for near duplicate detection.
fields.thumbnail: Path to a 256 px JPEG under data/thumbs/.
fields.analysis_size: Pixel size the features were computed at.

described.owner: describing pass, then the edit tool

fields.alt_text: One plain sentence for screen readers.
fields.description: One neutral, concrete paragraph of what is visibly there.
fields.impression: One interpretive paragraph: a viewer's reading, mood, associations, what seems to be happening. Clearly a reading, not a fact.
fields.subjects: Tags from vocabulary.subjects: what is depicted.
fields.characters: Tags from vocabulary.characters: recurring beings and figure types.
fields.elements: Tags from vocabulary.elements: smaller visible components.
fields.line: Tags from vocabulary.line: mark and outline quality.
fields.color_words: Tags from vocabulary.color_words: the palette in words.
fields.style: Tags from vocabulary.style: lineages and references.
fields.themes: Tags from vocabulary.themes: recurring ideas across pieces.
fields.text_in_image: Object: present (bool), content (string or null), role (signature, title, lettering, graffiti, found signage).
fields.format_notes: Free text on materials and format as seen in the image: visible canvas weave, photographed under glare, white border, sketchbook page.
fields.free_tags: Free text tags that fit no facet yet. Candidates for the vocabulary.

relations.owner: describing pass, edit tool, and scripts/build_similarity.py for computed ones

item.type: One of: variation_of, source_of, same_characters, same_scene, series_pair, revisits, step_toward, near_duplicate.

fields.verified: True once Matt has reviewed the described block.
fields.notes: Anything Matt wants to say about the piece or the tagging.
fields.hidden: Optional. True removes the piece from the public build entirely.
